stem:
A random variable $X$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{k}{x^2} & 1 \leqslant x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ and $a$ are positive constants.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the 60th percentile of $X$ in terms of $a$.
